summary: Decomposition is sound: WI-06d splits into one leaf (WI-06d-a, geometry replacement in all critical-path areas, world content data) and two nested stories (WI-06d-b: six section 48 juice effects plus the cross-band contrast walk, rendering; WI-06d-c: section 16 shake rules and widescreen, camera). All nested children exist and each of the nine leaves holds one behavior with at most three named changed responsibilities (verified in detail for WI-06d-a, WI-06d-b4, WI-06d-b6, WI-06d-c-a; frontmatter checked for b1/b2/b3/b5, c-b). Dependencies are correct: WI-06d and all leaves inherit WI-06a/b/c; the cross-branch edges are explicit in leaf frontmatter (WI-06d-b6 -> b1..b5, WI-06d-c-a -> WI-06d-b4); no leaf depends on an ancestor or descendant; the downstream WI-06g -> WI-06d edge correctly means all leaves. Acceptance is preserved: ST-06's AC-art-geometry and AC-art-palettes texts are retained verbatim at every level, and the children's union (a: AC-art-geometry; b/b6: both; c: child-local AC-shake-rules and AC-widescreen) covers both parent criteria. Final proof ownership is unique and named to leaves: geometry part of AC-art-geometry -> WI-06d-a (recorded per-area before/after walk, 1080p, section 34 spot-check); juice part of AC-art-geometry and the AC-art-palettes cross-band walk -> WI-06d-b6 (six-effect re-trigger plus per-band identity-factor walk, verification-only with findings routed as defect reports); AC-shake-rules -> WI-06d-c-a (flag on/off browser proof with the WI-06d-b4 impulse plus Node unit tests, which also owns the flag->shake integration proof that WI-06d-b4 explicitly defers); AC-widescreen -> WI-06d-c-b. Non-goals are consistent (no audio/map/a11y UI, no gameplay rules, spoiler rule for late-game recording). Minor, non-blocking: the WI-06d plan's 'why this shape' prose still calls b and c leaves and names WI-06d-b as juice proof owner from before their promotion to stories; the normative frontmatter is correct and the ownership chain resolves unambiguously to WI-06d-b6, so no revise is required.
